rules.statement: A party is bound to take steps and proceed with all possible and reasonable expedition to prosecute an action without allowing it to accumulate on the case list.
rules.supporting_quote: People may do what they like with their disputes as long as they do not invoke the assistance of the Courts of Law. But whenever that step has been taken they are bound to proceed with all possible and reasonable expedition, and it is the duty of their legal advisors and of the Courts themselves to seek that this is done.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code
